pairs.subject: the den of lions at dawn

left.scene: Daniel standing calm and upright in the centre of the den, arms relaxed at his sides.; Several lions crouched or lying on the floor at varying distances from Daniel; Darius in court robes with a signet ring at the rim above, leaning forward; a faint luminous light suggesting the angel's presence without a visible human form.
